entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Be nuga an nudakedi, Be an Baba, Pe pinsadí anudakégala. Pe purba anualicágwa, perguunanmala an bendake. Pe purba anue oguaegala, netirpiimákar abdalibgua. Pe do di napirguad tummagan, percuable per carmadí.
